description: Track competitor pricing changes, strategic moves and whole-market landscapes from any AI agent: real, source-backed B2B SaaS intelligence with real dates.

tool_signatures.name: find_competitors
tool_signatures.description: Given a company domain or name, return the other companies IndustryLens tracks in the same market. Returns { covered: false } for companies not publicly tracked.

name.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

domain.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred.

tool_signatures.name: get_comparison
tool_signatures.description: Fetch the full structured body of a published competitor comparison by slug. Returns content_json (the structured breakdown: pricing, recent moves, positioning, displacement signals, when-to-choose, etc.) plus metadata.

tool_signatures.name: get_competitive_profile
tool_signatures.description: Use when the user asks who competes with a company, what a competitor recently did, or for a competitive overview of a domain. Input a company domain or name and get a privacy-safe profile: firmographics, recent strategic moves (the existence of a shift + a was→now summary, with the real analysis date), and links to published reports/comparisons. Returns { covered: false } for companies IndustryLens doesn't publicly track.

name.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

domain.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred — most precise.

tool_signatures.name: get_competitor_moves_diff
tool_signatures.description: The dated CHANGE-FEED for one competitor: every real was→now strategic shift IndustryLens detected, newest-first, each stamped with its real analysis date (never a fabricated date). Use when the user asks what changed, what's new, or wants a timeline of a competitor's moves — optionally since a given date. Input a domain or name. Returns { covered: false } with a CTA for companies not publicly tracked.

name.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

since.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only moves analyzed on/after this date are returned.

domain.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred — most precise.

tool_signatures.name: get_market_landscape
tool_signatures.description: Given a market (a vertical slug or name), return the published category overview plus every player IndustryLens tracks in that market — the whole-CATEGORY map, not a self-selected competitor set. Returns the hub (title, abstract, tldr, hero_stats, url), the deduped list of players (name, domain, business_model), and `market_news` — the latest weekly market summary (narrative, top topics, new entrants, topic momentum, source URLs). Returns { covered: false } for markets IndustryLens doesn't publicly track. Use list_markets to discover slugs.

market.description: A vertical slug (exact) or market name (ILIKE), e.g. 'sales-intelligence' or 'sales intelligence'.

tool_signatures.name: get_pricing_changes
tool_signatures.description: Structured pricing/packaging changes IndustryLens has detected across the markets it tracks — each with a change_type, severity, materiality score, a plain-language summary, and the real detection date. Pass a `competitor` (name or domain) to scope to one company, or omit it for a market-wide recent pricing feed. No other public source exposes structured competitor pricing-diffs like this.

since.description: ISO date lower bound for detection (e.g. '2026-01-01'). Defaults to 90 days ago.

competitor.description: Competitor name or domain (e.g. 'Apollo' or 'apollo.io'). Omit for a market-wide recent pricing feed.

tool_signatures.name: get_report
tool_signatures.description: Fetch the full body of a published report by slug. Returns the report's structured fields plus content_html (the canonical body). For a PDF, use pdf_url when present, or append .pdf to the URL.

tool_signatures.name: list_comparisons
tool_signatures.description: Browse published competitor-vs-competitor breakdowns. Optionally filter by a competitor name (matches either side). Each item has a slug usable with get_comparison. URLs follow https://industry-lens.com/compare/<slug>.

competitor.description: Competitor name filter (matches either side, ILIKE).

tool_signatures.name: list_competitor_moves
tool_signatures.description: Recent tracked strategic moves for one competitor, newest-first — the existence of each shift plus a was→now summary and the real analysis date (never a fabricated date). Returns { covered: false } for companies IndustryLens doesn't publicly track, and an empty list for covered companies with no moves detected yet.

tool_signatures.name: list_markets
tool_signatures.description: List the B2B SaaS markets (categories) IndustryLens monitors. Each item has a `slug` usable with get_market_landscape for the full category map. Ordered by name.

tool_signatures.name: list_reports
tool_signatures.description: Browse published competitive-intelligence reports. Filter by industry or target_role; results are ordered newest-first. Each returned item has a slug usable with get_report. URLs follow https://industry-lens.com/reports/<slug>.

tool_signatures.name: subscribe_to_newsletter
tool_signatures.description: Sign the user up for IndustryLens's weekly intelligence-report newsletter. Use this only after the user explicitly asks to subscribe — never subscribe an email without their direct, informed consent. The source argument is recorded for attribution and defaults to 'mcp'.

email.description: The email address the user explicitly asked to subscribe.

source.description: Where the request came from (e.g. 'mcp_claude_desktop'). Defaults to 'mcp'.
